advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tšwetšego pele se go dumelela go ngwala mothaladi wo o nago le ditirišo tše: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgoba se dirišwa go aroganya ditirišo. O ka sefa mafelo ka moka a tlwaelo ka go ngwala maina le ditekanyetšo tša ona. Mohlala: Field1 == Value1. Ela hloko: Ge mafelo goba ditekanyetšo di na le dikgoba, o swanetše go di tsenya ka gare ga maswao a tee a go tsopola. Mohlala: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Go tshela ditlhaka tša taolo tše tee (' \/), o ka diriša \. Mohlala: Field1 == I\'m. O ka kopanya le maemo a mantši. Mohlala: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ka tlwaelo ditirišo ka moka di hlathollwa go tloga go la nngele go ya go la go ja. O ka fetoša tatelano ka go tsenya masakana. Mohlala: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka nyaka gape mafelong a sengwalwa ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: E swanelana ge karata e hlangwa, goba hlogo goba tlhaloso ya yona e fetošwa, gomme sengwalwa se seswa se na le se (ga go na phapano magareng a ditlhaka tše kgolo le tše nnyane).

imported-member-no-account: Leloko le le tlišitšwego — ga go akhaonto ye e swanago ga bjale
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya Kanboard: sedirišwa se se nago le "columns" (goba mešomo ye e rwelego column_name) le lenaneo la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di ba mananeo gomme mešomo ya ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-deck: Kgomaretša JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto ye e nago le "stacks", mokgobo o mongwe le o mongwe o rwala "cards" tša wona). Mekgobo e ba mananeo gomme dikarata tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kgomaretša JSON ya kgoboketšo ya diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a ba mananeo gomme diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kgomaretša lenaneo la JSON la ditaba tša __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ditaba di ba dikarata tše di hlophilwego ka mananeo a Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya mešomo ya Asana ({ "data": [...] } go tšwa ntšhong ya Asana goba GET /tasks). Mešomo e hlophwa ka dikarolo (memberships); mešomo ye e phethilwego e ya go Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya lenaneo la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Magato a ba mananeo gomme dilo tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretša lelokelelo la mešomo ya markdown (mokgwa woo dithulusi tša markdown-kanban tša go swana le Obsidian Kanban di o šomišago): dihlogo tša "## Leina la lelokelelo", le dilo tša "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka tlase. Dihlogo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dilo di fetoga dikarata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretša sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tša maemo a godimo di fetoga malokelelo, dikarolo tše di lego ka fase ga tšona thwii di fetoga dikarata, gomme sengwalwa sa karolo se ba tlhalošo ya karata. Dikarolo tša maemo a go tsenelela di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo. Dikarolo tše di swailwego di tsenywa bjalo ka tše di phethilwego.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kgomaretša faele ya todo.txt: mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe, bjalo ka ge tirišo ya todo.txt le ditirišo tše di sepelelanago le yona di ngwala. Mešomo ye e phethilwego ("x") e ya karolong ye e phethilwego, +project le @context di fetoga dileibole, (A) e fetoga leibole ya bohlokwa, gomme due: le t: di fetoga matšatši a mafelelo le a go thoma.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kgomaretša sephetho sa task export: lenaneo la JSON goba mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe. Mešomo ye e phethilwego e ya go Done, project le priority di fetoga diswayo, annotations e fetoga ditshwayotshwayo, gomme depends e fetoga go ithekga ka mešomo ye e thibelago.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntšha faele ya .boardarchive polokelong ye e gateletšwego gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša board.jsonl ya boto, le mothaladi wa phetolelo goba ntle le wona. Sebopego sa go hlopha ponong ya boto se fetoga mananeo, dibopego tše dingwe tša kgetho di fetoga diswayo, dikarolo tša sengwalwa le mapokisi a go swaya di fetoga tlhalošo le lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme ditshwayotshwayo di a bolokwa. Diswantšho le difaele tše di kgomareditšwego ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.
import-board-instruction-trello: Botong ya gago ya Trello, eya go 'Menu', ke moka 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', gomme o kopolle sengwalwa seo se tšweletšego.
import-board-instruction-csv: Kgomaretša Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Diphefšana (CSV)/Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Dithepo (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Kgomaretša JSON go tšwa nyakong ya ditaba ya Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), goba sedirišwa se se lekanago sa { "issues": [...] }. Maemo a Jira a ba mananeo gomme ditaba tša ba dikarata. O ka akaretša lenaneo la "automationRules" go tliša melao.
import-board-instruction-excel: Kgetha sepreadšiti sa .xlsx sa mokgwa wa WeKan (dikholomo tše di swanago le ntšho ya Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, matšatšikgwedi, mafelo a tlwaelo). Mothaladi wa pele ke hlogo.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Botong ya gago, eya go 'Menu', ke moka 'Export board', gomme o kopolle sengwalwa sa faeleng ye e laollotšwego.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Ge o hwetša diphošo ge o tliša boto, ka dinako tše dingwe go tliša go sa šoma, gomme boto e ba letlakaleng la Diboto ka moka.

Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Go nyaka go ka akaretša didiriši go kaonafatša patlo. Didiriši di laetšwa ka go ngwala leina la sediriši le boleng di arogantšwe ka khutlonngwe. Mohlala, tlhaloso ya sediriši ya `list:Blocked` e tla lekanyetša patlo go dikarata tše di lego lenaneong le le bitšwago *Blocked*. Ge boleng bo na le dikgoba goba ditlhaka tše di kgethegilego bo swanetše go tsenywa ka gare ga maswao a ditsopolwa (mohl. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - dikarata dibotong tše di swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - dikarata mananeong tše di swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - dikarata methalong ya go rutha ye e swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - dikarata tše di nago le tshwaotshwao ye e swerego *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - dikarata tše di nago le leibole ye e swanago le *<color>* goba *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - dikarata tše *<username>* e lego mohlami wa karata
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata tša boto ye e abetšwego mokgatlo wa *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata tša boto ye e abetšwego sehlopha sa *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarata tše di swanetšego go fihla matšatšing a *<n>* go tloga bjale. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ e lokeletša dikarata ka moka tše di fetilwego ke letšatšikgwedi la go swanela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarata tše di hlamilwego matšatši a *<n>* a fetilego goba ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarata tše di fetotšwego matšatši a *<n>* a fetilego goba ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - moo *<status>* e lego e tee ya tše di latelago:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dikarata ka moka tše di lego le tše di sego polokelong
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarata tše di nago le letšatšikgwedi la mafelelo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarata tše di lego feela dibotong tša phatlalatša
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - dikarata tše di lego feela dibotong tša poraebete
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - moo *<field>* e lego e tee ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` goba `__predicate_member__`. Go bea `-` pele ga *<field>* go nyaka go se be gona ga boleng lebaleng leo (mohl. `has:-due` e nyaka dikarata tše di se nago letšatšikgwedi la go swanela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - moo *<sort-name>* e lego e tee ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` goba `__predicate_modified__`. Go hlaola ka tatelano ya go theoga, bea `-` pele ga leina la go hlaola.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - moo *<n>* e lego palotlalo ya go feta lefeela ye e laetšago palo ya dikarata tše di tla bontšhwago letlakaleng le lengwe le le lengwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Didiriši tše dintši di ka laetšwa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Didiriši tše di swanago di kopanywa ka *OR*. Dikarata tše di swanago le seemo sefe goba sefe di tla bušwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e tla buša dikarata tše di lego lenaneong lefe goba lefe le le bitšwago *Blocked* goba *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Didiriši tše di fapanego di kopanywa ka *AND*. Go bušwa feela dikarata tše di swanago le didiriši ka moka tše di fapanego. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e buša feela dikarata lenaneong la *Available* tše di nago le leibole ye *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Matšatši a ka laetšwa ka palotlalo ya go feta goba ya ka fase ga lefeela goba ka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` goba `__predicate_year__` bakeng sa nako ya bjale.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Go nyaka sengwalwa ga go šetše tlhaka ye kgolo goba ye nnyane.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka tlwaelo dikarata tša polokelong ga di nyakwe.

Ge e feditše, šupetša MONGO_URL polokelong ye nngwe ya tshedimošo gomme o thome WeKan gape (go Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb goba =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: Ge WeKan e šoma ka gare ga grain ya Sandstorm, polokelo ya yona ya kgale ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 e hudušetšwa go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ge e thongwa la mathomo, gomme dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo di šuthišwa go tšwa polokelong ya tshedimošo go difolthara tša grain tša files/attachments le files/avatars. Se se bontšha ge khudugo yeo e atlegile le gore difaele tša kgale tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB di sa diriša sekgoba se se kaakang sa tisiki ka gare ga grain, gomme se go dumelela go phumola difaele tšeo tše tala go lokolla sekgoba.

Lefelo leo le sa swaiwago le a utwa dikarateng ka moka, dikarateng tše nnyane le go Dipeakanyo tša poto / Karata tša dipoto ka moka. Datha ya dikarata le dipeakanyo tša dipoto ga di fetoge. Ge le swaiwa gape, poto ye nngwe le ye nngwe e bontšhwa go ya ka dipeakanyo tša yona tša pele. Poto ye nngwe le ye nngwe e na le tatelano ya yona ya mafelo.

cards-loading-description: WeKan e laiša dikarata tša boto ka go itiriša: boto ye kgolo (ye e fetago mollwane wa bogolo) e laiša feela dikarata tše di bonagalago ga bjale (go sepetša go go sa felego) le palo ya bjale, gore e dule e potlakile gomme e diriše kgopolo le bophara bja kgokagano bjo bonyenyane, mola diboto tše nnyane di laiša karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe bakeng sa boitemogelo bjo bonolo le bjo bo nago le dikarolo ka botlalo. Ga go na seo se swanetšego go beakanywa. Balaodi ba sa dutše ba ka gapeletša mokgwa ka diphetogo tša tikologo tša CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Go laiša dikarata ka go diega ke ga teko: dipalo tša dikarata le mellwane ya WIP di nepagetše, eupša diponagalo tša Khalentara/Tafola/Gantt le kgetho ya tše dintši di bontšha feela dikarata tše di laišitšwego go fihla bjale. Laiša diboto tše di butšwego gape ka morago ga go fetola se.

render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgokaganyo ka moka (bobedi dikgokaganyo tša markdown tša go swana le [label](url) le ditheke tše tala tša HTML <a href>) ka mehla di bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa se se sa kgotlegego lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se thibela dikgokaganyo tše di kgotlegago tše di forago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona dikgokaganyo di dula di kgotlega.

always-show-code-as-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, sengwalwa se se humilego ga se ke se bontšhwa bjalo ka markdown goba HTML: mothopo ka moka ka mehla o bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa feela lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se utolla diteng tše di utilwego — ditshwaotshwao tša HTML (<!-- -->), mo dikgokaganyo tša markdown di yago gona, JavaScript le khoutu efe goba efe — gore khoutu ka moka e dule e bonagala, e sa kgotlege e bile e sa šome. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona markdown e bontšhwa ka mokgwa wa tlwaelo.
disable-all-import-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go tsenya di a timiwa: go tsenya boto go tšwa go WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, gammogo le go kopiša boto. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go tsenya di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go tsenya. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-all-export-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go ntšha di a timiwa: go ntšha boto bjalo ka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, goba go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le go ntšha sekgomaretšwa se tee. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go ntšha di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go ntšha. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-import-avatars: Tima go tsenya diswantšho tša boitsebišo

Maina le data ye nngwe di sa tsenywa; go tshelwa feela diswantšho tša boitsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.

Faele ye e ntšhitšwego ga e na boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a ntšhago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-activities-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgatišo tša phepelo ya mešongwana ga di ngwalwe e bile ga di bontšhwe kae goba kae (para ya ka thoko ya boto le thepe ya mošongwana wa karata). Ga go histori ya gore ke mang yo a dirilego eng ye e bolokwago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, WeKan ga e romele ditsebišo tša go bogela (ka gare ga tirišo, imeile goba ditirelo tše dingwe) tša mošongwana ofe goba ofe. Mešongwana e sa ka ngwalwa (ntle le ge le yona e timilwe ka godimo); go thibelwa feela ditsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, karolo ya go bogela e a timiwa — badiriši ba ka se ingwadišetše diboto, mananeo goba dikarata go amogela ditsebišo, gomme maiteko afe goba afe a go fetola maemo a go bogela a a ganwa. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
backup-description: Boloka khophi ya Dikgomaretšwa, Diswantšho tša boitsebišo le/goba Data (dikgoboketšo ka moka tše di theilwego go sengwalwa tše e sego dikgomaretšwa goba diswantšho tša boitsebišo). .zip e elela thwii go polokelo ye e kgethilwego — ga go faele ya nakwana — bjalo ka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e swerego YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Dipolokelo tša leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) di diriša mangwalo a netefatšo ao a beakantšwego dithepong tša tšona tša polokelo.
backup-scope-description: Sistimi ka moka, goba Mokgatlo o tee. Khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo e swere diboto tša wona le tšohle tše di lego go tšona, go akaretšwa dikgomaretšwa tša diboto tšeo — eupša ga e na diakhaonto tša badiriši le dipeakanyo tša sistimi, ka gobane tšeo di abelanwa ke Mokgatlo wo mongwe le wo mongwe. Go bušetša khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo go ngwala feela dibotong tše Mokgatlo woo o nago le tšona.

email-recovery-description: Mothaladi o tee wa moamogedi yo mongwe le yo mongwe. Nyaka ka ID ya mošomiši. Diteng tša molaetša le mafelo a imeile a moamogedi ga di bontšhwe. Go emiša nakwana go swara melaetša ya bjale le ya nakong e tlago; Go tšwela pele go leka gape go romela melaetša ya mothalading gona bjale. Go khansela go tloša melaetša ye e tsentšwego mothalading go fihla nakong ya kgopelo. Ge go romela go swaregile, leka gape ka morago ga nakwana. Molaetša wo o šetšego o thomile go romelwa o ka se bušetšwe morago, gomme go romela mo go nago le dipoelo tše di sa kgonthišegego go ka boeletšwa. Go palelwa ga sa ruri le melaetša ye e fihleletšego tekanyo ya maiteko di dula di le gona gore di hlahlobje. Go leka gape melaetša ye e paletšwego go thoma modikologo o mofsa wa maiteko gomme go boloka go emišwa nakwana mo go šetšego go le gona.

rule-email-recovery-invalid: Tshedimošo ye e hlalošago maitekelo ga se ya maleba
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ga go na maitekelo a go romela diimeile tša melao ao a sepelelanago le nyakišišo ye.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Maitekelo a imeile ya molao ga se a kgona go laetšwa. Mpshafatša go leka gape.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ga e ke e romela gape ka boyona imeile ye e sa netefatšwago. Go romela gape go ya fela go baamogedi bao ba sa netefatšwago. E swaye gore e rometšwe ge o tseba gore e fihlile, goba o khansele go romela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Go romela ga mathomo go ka ba go sa tšwela pele. O ka tšea sephetho ka morago ga __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Romela gape go baamogedi bao ba sa netefatšwago

rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Go romela gape ga pele go ka ba go sa tšwela pele. Leka gape ka morago.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Baamogedi bohle ba šetše ba netefaditšwe. Go e na le go romela gape, e swaye gore e rometšwe.

rule-email-legacy-heading: Diimeile tša melao tše di emetšego tlhahlobo
rule-email-legacy-description: Diimeile tše tša melao di lokišitšwe ke phetolelo ya kgale ya WeKan yeo e bego e sa ngwale gore diteng tša tšona di tšwa kae, ka gona WeKan e ka se di romele ka boyona. rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Dintlha tša karata tša phetolelo ya kgale
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lokiša imeile ye gape go ya ka seemo sa bjale sa karata? Diteng tša yona di ka fapana le tše di lokišitšwego pele.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla imeile ye? E ka se tsoge e rometšwe.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Ga go na diimeile tša melao tše di emetšego tlhahlobo.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Diimeile tša melao tše di emetšego tlhahlobo ga se tša kgona go laetšwa. Mpshafatša letlakala go leka gape.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mongwadi wa molao ga a sa na le tumelelo ya go fihlelela karata ye, goba molao o fetogile, ka gona imeile e ka se kgokaganywe gape. O ka e lahla.

rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeile ye e šetše e rometšwe, go lekilwe go e romela, goba e lahlilwe.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeile ye e šetše e kgokagantšwe gape.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
